children: According to ChainCatcher, trader Ansem said ZEC, HYPE and PUMP may bottom on Monday or Tuesday, setting November lows before rising the following week. He said the three tokens appear positioned for a potential rebound and expects a relief rally ahead of the Christmas rally. In an earlier post, Ansem said DRV, VVV and PEARL may be less correlated with the broader market and each have independent bullish theses.

title: Ansem Says ZEC, HYPE and PUMP May Bottom on Monday or Tuesday
